blocks.orig: Tarangire Ndovu Tented Lodge is located in the heart of Tarangire. The 15 permanent tents (including two family- and one honeymoon tent) are spacious, built with local materials and lovingly furnished in ecru and wood. All tents boast comfy beds, sofas, double sliding doors with mosquito netting to keep tiny unwanted guests out and large wooden decks to enjoy the sunset. Here, you choose to relax on your veranda, or by the swimming pool situated on yet another wooden deck, overlooking the Tarangire savannah. Right behind the pool, you will find the restaurant, where chefs create fine bush cuisine using fresh produce. At night, a guard walks you to the main deck or back to your tent, while lanterns, solar lights and scented candles light your way creating a beautiful romantic atmosphere under the African night sky!
blocks.html: In the heart of Tarangire you find Tarangire Ndovu Tented Lodge. Its 15 permanent tents (two family tents and one honeymoon tent among them) are roomy, made from local materials and furnished with care in ecru and wood. Every tent has comfortable beds, sofas, double sliding doors with mosquito netting to keep small uninvited guests outside, and a large wooden deck for watching the sunset. You can unwind on your veranda or at the swimming pool, which sits on another wooden deck looking out over the Tarangire savannah. Just behind the pool is the restaurant, where the chefs prepare fine bush cuisine from fresh ingredients. After dark a guard accompanies you to the main deck or back to your tent, with lanterns, solar lights and scented candles lighting the path and creating a lovely romantic mood beneath the African night sky!
